Section 2.4: Software Requirements

This section outlines the software requirements for the STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller, focusing on the peripherals and their respective pins. The system is designed to monitor soil moisture levels, alert users via a buzzer when soil moisture falls below a certain threshold, and provide real-time telemetry over USB.
bullets: ADC (Analog-to-Digital Converter) for soil moisture measurement
GPIO (General Purpose Input/Output) pins for active buzzer alert, onboard status LED, and serial communication
